basis: Configurable rules layer. Advisory logic lives here, NOT inline in frontend JavaScript. Thresholds are illustrative agronomic starting points and must be reviewed by an agronomist before any field use.
disclaimer: Illustrative demo data — advisory thresholds are configurable defaults, not validated agronomic prescriptions.
default_risk_message: No configured threshold crossed for this crop in the selected Panchayat.

tomato.label: Tomato

high.trigger: forecast daily maximum temperature at or above 36 C
high.action: Advance harvest of mature and breaker-stage fruit to the early morning window, irrigate at dawn and again in the late afternoon, and apply a 50 percent shade-net or straw mulch cover over the fruiting rows.
high.field_operation: Shift spraying and transplanting to before 09:00.

medium.trigger: forecast daily maximum temperature at or above 33 C
medium.action: Irrigate at dawn, mulch the root zone, and monitor for flower drop and blossom-end rot over the next 48 hours.
medium.field_operation: Keep afternoon field operations to a minimum.

tomato.market_hint: Heat-stressed tomato reaches market earlier and softer — compare the mandi benchmark and institutional buyer offers before committing the lot.
tomato.logistics_hint: Harvest in the cool window and book a reefer or an early-morning pickup to limit field heat.

onion.label: Onion

high.trigger: forecast daily maximum temperature at or above 37 C
high.action: Stop irrigation 10 to 14 days before lifting to harden the neck, then lift in the early morning and cure under shade rather than in open sun.

medium.trigger: forecast daily maximum temperature at or above 34 C
medium.action: Maintain light, frequent irrigation and inspect stored bulbs for sunscald and neck rot.

onion.market_hint: Heat raises storage losses — check the mandi price outlook and consider an earlier sale to a storage-linked buyer.
onion.logistics_hint: Prioritise ventilated transport over sealed trucks for cured bulbs.

grape.label: Grape

high.trigger: forecast daily maximum temperature at or above 38 C
high.action: Run overhead misting or drip in the pre-dawn hours, keep the canopy cover intact, and defer pruning and gibberellic-acid operations by two days.
high.field_operation: Shift all canopy work outside the 11:00 to 16:00 window.

medium.trigger: forecast daily maximum temperature at or above 35 C
medium.action: Increase irrigation frequency and inspect for berry sunburn on the exposed western side of the canopy.
medium.field_operation: Delay any stress-inducing operation to the evening.

grape.market_hint: Check export-grade compliance windows: heat-affected berries often fail grading and are better routed to the domestic channel.
grape.logistics_hint: Book reefer capacity before harvest so the fruit does not hold at ambient temperature.

wheat.label: Wheat

high.trigger: terminal heat stress window (daily maximum at or above 35 C)
high.action: Apply a light irrigation at the grain-filling stage, and plan harvest within the next few days if grain moisture already permits.
high.field_operation: Avoid late top-dressing; finish threshing preparations.

medium.trigger: forecast daily maximum temperature at or above 32 C
medium.action: Keep the crop irrigated at grain filling and monitor for shrivelled grain.
medium.field_operation: Harvest machinery slot to be booked in advance.

wheat.market_hint: Check the government mandi feed: early arrivals often clear at a better price than heat-shrivelled late arrivals.
wheat.logistics_hint: Align threshing and pickup on the same day to avoid double handling.

soybean.label: Soybean

high.trigger: forecast daily maximum temperature at or above 36 C
high.action: Irrigate the pod-filling block at dawn and defer any inter-cultivation to avoid root damage under heat stress.

medium.trigger: forecast daily maximum temperature at or above 33 C
medium.action: Protect soil moisture with mulch and scout for pod-borer activity, which rises with temperature.

soybean.market_hint: Compare the mandi benchmark against institutional oil-mill offers before selling.
soybean.logistics_hint: Bag and move the lot the same day to preserve moisture content.

banana.label: Banana

high.trigger: forecast daily maximum temperature at or above 37 C
high.action: Irrigate heavily in the early morning, protect bunches with leaf cover or bagging, and postpone harvest of green fruit by a day if possible.

medium.trigger: forecast daily maximum temperature at or above 34 C
medium.action: Maintain irrigation and monitor for leaf scorch and premature ripening.
medium.field_operation: Harvest in the coolest part of the day.

banana.market_hint: Heat advances ripening — check the price index and quick-commerce channel demand before holding the lot.
banana.logistics_hint: Use a reefer or a pre-cooled truck; ambient transport will accelerate ripening.

rainfall_rules.note: Rainfall risk is P1 and ships only if the rainfall residual model validates. Until then the heat-risk advisory is the guaranteed demonstration path.

high.trigger: forecast rainfall at or above 50 mm for the day
high.action: Delay harvest and field operations, secure drainage channels, and hold the lot under cover.
high.field_operation: Postpone all field work until rainfall subsides.
high.logistics_hint: Expect rural road access to degrade — reschedule pickup.

medium.trigger: forecast rainfall at or above 20 mm for the day
medium.action: Cover harvested produce and check drainage around the storage area.
medium.field_operation: Harvest early in the day and secure the storage area.
medium.logistics_hint: Confirm the pickup vehicle can reach the farm gate.
